exposure: Arrest disorder as indication for previous caesarean birth
arrest disorder as indication for previous caesarean birth
Women with a low predicted probability of VBAC
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 541 women electing to have a VBAC at a regional hospital over a nine-year period
finding: The updated Grobman nomogram without ethnicity demonstrated good fit for predicting successful VBAC, with an AUC of 0.707, but performed poorly in women with a low predicted probability of VBAC.
